text: Clue isi video mein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Dulhan ke papa\nRAMESH JI mare mile!
Police ne bataya:\n"ZEHAR diya gaya hai"
BHAI MAHESH\n"Poori shaam mithai\nbaant raha tha"
PATNI SUNITA\n"9 baje dawaai di,\nphir pooja mein thi"

NAUKAR RAMU\n"Gilaas kaali T-shirt\nwale ko diya tha"
